title: Case: Part of a two-carton desk order has not arrived
context: Order TG-1275 was shipped as two separately labelled cartons. Both show delivery scans from the same day, made at different times and in different ways.
initial_request: Only half of TG-1275 has shown up. Your tracking says the whole lot is delivered. Where is the rest? I took a day off work for this and I'm not paying for a desk I can't build.

events.body: TG-1275 for Maelis Quarrie left us today as two cartons on separate labels: DL-7063 standing desk frame (long flat carton, 31 kg) and DL-4746 desk top (square carton, 18 kg). Both handed to Gorsewick Arc at 15:10.

End of day status for TG-1275. DL-7063: delivery scan 2027-04-07 10:12, driver note 'left in porch'. DL-4746: delivery scan 2027-04-07 15:47, different driver, note 'handed to resident'. Both closed on our side.

Only half of TG-1275 has shown up. Your tracking says the whole lot is delivered. Where is the rest? I took a day off work for this and I'm not paying for a desk I can't build.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-541.txt

attachments.name: label-scan-541.txt
attachments.text:
LABEL SCAN

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask which of the two cartons has arrived: the desk frame (DL-7063) or the desk top (DL-4746).

must: Asks Maelis Quarrie which carton has arrived and which is missing, naming the desk frame (DL-7063) and the desk top (DL-4746) or their label references
Sends the question to Maelis Quarrie before any trace is requested
Avoids stating that the missing carton is lost, stolen or delivered
must_not: Asks the Parcel trace team or Dispatch to trace DL-7063 on the assumption that the porch-drop carton is the missing one
Tells Maelis Quarrie that the missing carton was delivered, or that it is lost or stolen
Promises a refund, a replacement or a redelivery date
Asks for anything beyond which carton arrived, such as proof of identity, a door code or payment details
Treats label-scan-541.txt as evidence about DL-7063: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-18078)
Tells anyone that DL-7063 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-541.txt
expected.reference_message: I am sorry part of your order is missing. TG-1275 was sent as two cartons with their own labels: the desk frame (long flat carton, label DL-7063) and the desk top (square carton, label DL-4746). Please tell me which one you have received, or the DL number on the label of the carton that did arrive. With that I can ask the carrier to trace the right one. I cannot say yet where the other carton is.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-302: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. label-scan-541.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-18078); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
